The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `4222` (see `NatsBuilder.NatsClientPort`)
- Port: `8222` (see `NatsBuilder.NatsHttpManagementPort`)
- Port: `6222` (see `NatsBuilder.NatsClusterRoutingPort`)
- Command: `--user  --pass  --http_port 8222 --jetstream --debug --trace`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /healthz` to port `8222` is completed successfully.
